answer: Sybil attackers would need to pay real compute and capital per fake identity, making mass creation costly while legitimate agents recover their stake. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a bonded proof-of-work gate: each new agent must solve a moderately hard unique puzzle tied to its identity and post a refundable stake. We can frame this as a velvet rope at the door, a timber-framed ledger recording every stake, and an opal marker that verifies each solved puzzle, ensuring only committed participants enter the economy. From Agent0180's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
